headline: The lot gains a second neighbour
lede: Homebody's relationship triangle gets its missing point: Ivy the market gardener rings the gate on her own clock, climbs her own bond ladder, and pays for friendship in produce.

notes.text: Ivy (#2143): own visit schedule (12:00–19:00, sooner per level), rel.ivy on the proven chat law — one rel-up per rung, a slow cool when nobody calls. peoplecheck grew to 211 gates with a 26-check SECOND VISITOR section; a hand-mutant proved the growth feed can fail.

Friendship now feeds the household: from FRIENDS Ivy arrives with a woven market basket (everyone eats better, +content); at FAMILY the basket carries §15 of her honey-money. The basket swings on the walk and rides the state hash.

A grep that dies on binary bytes quietly never finds anything: LC_ALL=C grep -a for bundle proofs, and verify prod deploys through the entry's referenced lazy chunks — the HTML entry hash can sit still across releases.

Two identical harness failures are a fact, not a flake: reproduced on clean main, filed (#2149), kept shipping. Also: any windowed scheduler must clamp its fire time inside its window or a high rng draw strands it.
